summary: Canadian National Railway Co (CN) filed a Form 6-K announcing a public debt offering of US$750 million, consisting of US$300 million 4.350% Notes due 2029 and US$450 million 4.950% Notes due 2036 under an effective shelf registration statement. Joint bookrunners are J.P. Morgan, RBC Capital Markets, and SMBC Nikko. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including commercial paper repayment. The offering closes May 12, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is an ordinary debt financing transaction, not a special situation, as it lacks any transformative corporate event such as an acquisition, spin-off, or restructuring.
